subject: Request: Pro-rata service offset for Q3 over-usage
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <accounts@clearsky.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Billing question re: invoice CSK-2026-09-0045 (Q3 usage spike)

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you're well — I'm Alyssa in ClearSky's accounting team. We noticed a significant usage spike on our September invoice (Invoice #CSK-2026-09-0045) that looks inconsistent with our normal pattern. I've attached our internal usage export and the PDF of the invoice for your review (usage_report_q3.csv; CSK-2026-09-0045-invoice.pdf).

Preliminarily it looks like ~150k extra tokens were billed under the "search-optimized" route; our engineering team says they didn't change traffic intentionally. Can Redwood confirm whether the spike was due to a metering misattribution or a model routing issue?

Given this is material for our Q3 close, we need a path to resolution quickly: either an invoice adjustment (credit memo) or a one-time service offset to cover the unexpected charges while we investigate. Our AP team is deadline-driven — can you advise the timeline to get an official credit memo or offset posted?

Thanks in advance,

Alyssa Park
Senior Accountant | ClearSky Analytics
accounts@clearsky.com
ATTACHMENTS: usage_report_q3.csv (csv), CSK-2026-09-0045-invoice.pdf (pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Park <accounts@clearsky.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing question re: invoice CSK-2026-09-0045 (Q3 usage spike)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for flagging this and for sending the attachments. I've looped in Revenue Ops (Marcus) and Billing (Neha) to investigate and propose a remediation.

High level: we will (a) review the meter logs for the period to determine attribution, (b) hold collection action on the disputed line items pending resolution, and (c) provide either a credit memo or a one-time service offset. To speed AP processing on your side, can you confirm whether ClearSky prefers:

- Option A: a credit memo applied to the existing invoice (reduces balance due immediately), or
- Option B: a one-time goodwill/service offset applied to the next invoice (no retro invoice change but compensatory credit applied forward).

If you prefer Option A, we'll need a short approval email from your AP to process the credit memo this pay cycle. If Option B, we can issue the offset within 7 business days and reflect it on your next statement.

Marcus / Neha — initial ask: please run the usage attribution, quantify the overcharged amount, and confirm tax treatment (ClearSky is US-headquartered; confirm whether any state sales tax rules apply). Also prepare a draft credit memo AND an adjusted invoice (if Option A).

Alyssa, I will follow up with a concrete dollar figure and the proposed remedy by EOD Thursday.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0197

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Park <accounts@clearsky.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Billing question re: invoice CSK-2026-09-0045 (Q3 usage spike)

Vanessa / Alyssa — revenue ops here. Summary of findings after reviewing meter logs and routing traces:

- Root cause: a transient routing policy change on 2026-09-14 caused ~148,700 tokens to be billed on the higher-cost search-optimized model variant. This was a configuration mismatch during a rolling update (internal).
- Gross overcharge (before tax) = USD 14,320.00.
- Proposed remediation: Issue a credit memo for USD 4,320.00 (to correct the direct overbilling) and a one-time goodwill service offset of USD 10,000.00 to acknowledge the operational impact to ClearSky during their close.

Tax/VAT note: ClearSky is US-based (per your domain) so no VAT applies. The credit memo will be processed as a US domestic credit; Redwood will provide a credit memo PDF and an adjusted invoice for your records. If ClearSky requires a specific remittance reference or GL code, please send that for the applied credit.

Action items / timeline:
- We will prepare RDW-creditmemo-127.pdf and RDW-adjusted-invoice-127.pdf and post the credit to your account by COB Monday, 2026-11-15.
- Collection hold: Redwood will mark the disputed line as "under review" and delay any automated dunning for 14 days to allow AP to review the paperwork.
- Alyssa: please confirm whether Option A (credit memo applied now) is acceptable. If yes, confirm AP email approval so we can finalize posting this week.

Attachments included for internal reference: calculation_worksheet_adj_127.xlsx (internal).

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
ATTACHMENTS: RDW-creditmemo-127.pdf (pdf stub), RDW-adjusted-invoice-127.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Alyssa Park <accounts@clearsky.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, payments@clearsky.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing question re: invoice CSK-2026-09-0045 (Q3 usage spike)

Vanessa / Marcus — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear breakdown. ClearSky approves Option A: please issue the credit memo and apply it to CSK-2026-09-0045. Our AP will accept the credit memo as documentation for our payment terms.

For our records, please send the final PDF credit memo and the adjusted invoice with the reference RDW-ADJ-2026-11-127 and indicate the posting date so our team can reconcile. We do not require any VAT handling. GL code for ClearSky: 4021-CloudServices-Exp.

Appreciate the goodwill offset — that helps smooth our Q3 close.

Best,
Alyssa Park
Senior Accountant | ClearSky Analytics
ATTACHMENTS: none
